# Localplay / 로컬플레이

> An on-device music player for the MP3 and audio files you already own.
> Pick files or a whole folder into a library, browse by track, album or
> artist, build playlists, queue songs, mark favorites, shuffle and repeat,
> shape the sound with a three-band equalizer and set playback speed.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://localplay.try-dabble.com/
The library, playlists, queue and settings stay in this browser on this device,
and the audio bytes are copied into the app's private storage on the same
device. No accounts, no uploads, no server storage, no subscription, no ads
during playback, no in-app purchases, no cap on tracks or playlists.

This is NOT a streaming service and NOT a music store. It never fetches songs
from the internet and never sends your files anywhere. It plays what is already
on the device, fully offline once the files are picked.

## Pages

- [Home](https://localplay.try-dabble.com/): The player and library
- [Privacy](https://localplay.try-dabble.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy
- [Terms](https://localplay.try-dabble.com/terms.html): Terms of use
- [Guide](https://try-dabble.com/guides/localplay): How-to on try-dabble.com

## Features

- Add files or a folder (File System Access where available, a file picker elsewhere)
- Title, artist and album read from ID3 tags, file name as the fallback, editable by hand
- Library views: Tracks, Albums, Artists, Playlists, Favorites, Recent
- Queue with add / remove / clear, shuffle, repeat off / all / one
- Three-band equalizer (bass, mid, treble) and playback speed 0.5x to 2x
- JSON export and import of track info, playlists, favorites and recents (no audio)
- Tracks relink to their audio by file name when the same folder is added again
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker; plays offline
